info.title: Chitty Logistics api
info.description: The one server every Chitty Logistics client calls. Every error response has the `ErrorBody` shape (docs/TECHNICAL.md, Error responses).

get.summary: Check the api and its database
get.description: Returns 200 when the api and its database answer, and 503 when the database does not. Needs no authentication.

200.description: The api and its database answer.

503.description: The api answers but its database does not.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response (docs/TECHNICAL.md, Error responses).

error.message: The requested resource was not found.

ErrorDetail.description: What went wrong, in a form clients can branch on and show.

code.description:
Stable snake_case identifier clients branch on, e.g. `not_found`, `forbidden`,
`unauthenticated`, `invalid_request`, `rate_limited`, `internal`. New codes may be
added; existing ones never change meaning.

details.description: Code-specific data (e.g. which fields are invalid), or null.

message.description: Human-readable and safe to show; never contains internal details.
message.example: The requested resource was not found.

request_id.description:
The request's `x-request-id` (sent by the client or generated), also returned as a
response header.

Health.description: Whether the api and its database answer.

database.description: `ok`, or `unavailable` when the database does not answer.

status.description: `ok` when everything answers, `degraded` when the database does not.

tags.name: health
tags.description: Liveness of the api and its database
